en.title: Game Developer – Unity, C#, Godot, Gameplay Programming
en.pitch: Gameplay programmer specializing in Unity (C#) and Godot (GDScript). Built HoldEmUp poker game with opponent AI – ranked top 2% of 2,175 entries in Brackey's 2026.2 Game Jam. Also created My House Is Built For You and Operation Redacted. Seeking game development internships and contract work.
